name: Cleanview US Data Center Map / Project List
pagination: Next.js streamed HTML; state/project links in page; likely no simple page query for complete table
notes: curl -L returned HTTP 200, 719080 bytes. Public page exposes US totals, top operating/planned cards, state links, and project detail URLs. Evidence in HTML: 3,049 total, 1,214 operating, 1,788 planned, 57,431 MW operating and 369,928 MW planned. Best value is planned-project discovery; need inspect app chunks/state pages for full list export or hidden API. No login needed for visible payload, but complete downloadable list/workaround not confirmed.

name: datacenterHawk
pagination: login/API gated; public marketing/resources pages only
notes: curl -L returned HTTP 200, 520270 bytes for marketing site. Public Nuxt payload exposes aggregate claims only: 10,500+ verified data centers, 113 markets, 344 GW power tracked, API docs/app domains. Robots/config blocks /data, /api, /rest, /iam; full market analytics requires app login or commercial API. Useful as benchmark/paid option, not a free scraper source.

name: Baxtel United States Data Center Market
pagination: HTML links to provider, market, region and facility pages; country page is not a complete facility list
notes: Initial guessed path /data-centers/united-states returned 404; corrected /data-center/united-states returned HTTP 200, 286414 bytes. Public country page reports 5,115 US facilities, top providers, largest facility, power-by-year/stage chart data, region cards, and facility links. Individual pages are crawlable. Strong free source for existing facilities and some construction/planned pipeline, but full enumeration likely needs sitemap/search crawling and dedupe across campuses/buildings/providers.

name: Data Center Map
pagination: directory pages by country/state/city/operator; curl currently rate-limited with 429
notes: curl to home, /usa/, and /usa/texas/dallas/ returned HTTP 429 with ~33 KB block page. Search index confirms free city/facility pages such as Dallas with 199 facilities and Helios Data Center in Dickens at 800 MW. Needs browser-like throttling, cached search, or respect crawl limits; not suitable as first automated source from plain curl in this environment.

name: DC Byte Map Search / Market Analytics
pagination: platform login/free trial; public marketing page only
notes: curl home returned HTTP 200, 260373 bytes; curl Search Data Centers returned HTTP 200, 253803 bytes. Public page says Map Search is part of Market Analytics/product packages, with start-free-trial/login links. It advertises 8,300+ facilities across 136+ countries and facility-level fields including status, capacity and operator, but no public project rows in HTML. Treat as commercial reference/possible paid acquisition source.

name: CBRE / JLL / Broker Data Center Reports
pagination: report pages/PDF downloads, not row-level pagination
notes: JLL North America Data Center Report Midyear 2026 returned HTTP 200, 286767 bytes. CBRE H2 2025 and Global Data Center Trends 2026 pages returned HTTP 403 to plain curl. Broker reports are useful for market totals, construction pipeline, vacancy/pricing, and trend validation; they usually do not publish a US-wide project-level table. If PDF links are available through browser, parse tables for market-level supply rather than project rows.

name: FracTracker National Data Centers Tracker
pagination: ArcGIS/dashboard layers; article/download links; likely map/layer API rather than classic pages
notes: curl tracker page returned HTTP 200, 130195 bytes; related April 2026 article returned HTTP 200, 906096 bytes. FracTracker describes an open-access, facility-level dataset/download usable for non-commercial purposes, updated daily, with address/coordinates, operator/tenant, reported MW demand, square footage, acreage, power sourcing, cooling, status, filters by state/county/status/hyperscale, and downloadable/shared data. High-priority free complement for proposed/under-construction AI projects, with advocacy/environmental context.

name: DCMap.us US Data Center Map
pagination: Astro app with /states, /markets, /counties, /insights; /api/map returned 403 to curl
notes: curl main page returned HTTP 200, 42410 bytes; /api/map returned HTTP 403. Public HTML exposes dataset metadata: 4,800 US facilities, 3,687 operational, 229 under construction, 857 planned/approved, 317 GW tracked, data updated Jul 2026, fields include capacity, pipeline status, climate risk, water stress and grid data. Promising free tracker if API access can be solved with browser/session headers; useful market/state pages are static and crawlable.

name: US Data Center Proposal Tracker

notes: curl returned HTTP 200, 5658 bytes. Public shell describes a citizen-run Data Center Proposal Tracker for proposals across the United States and infrastructure projects; page loads JS assets and Cloudflare Turnstile. No project rows or MW visible in initial HTML. Potential source for proposal discovery if bundled data/API endpoints can be found; lower confidence until map data access is tested in browser/devtools.

name: Cloudscene Data Center Directory
pagination: directory pages by country/city/facility; search/list pages likely client-side
notes: curl to a sample facility page returned HTTP 200, 92761 bytes. Search snippets and public pages expose address, operator, carriers, square feet and MW for individual colocation facilities. Good supplemental source for operating/colo sites, especially power and address validation; weaker for planned hyperscale pipeline and may require crawling city pages/search index.
